plainText:
Cristina Vee (born Cristina Valenzuela) is a voice actress and assistant voice director for the English-language dub of . She is also credited as Cristina Vee Valenzuela. She is currently affiliated with Atlas Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Vee was born on July 11, 1987, in Los Angeles, California. Her first role in was that of in Unrest at the Nursery!. She went on to voice Ash's Riolu in . Beginning with Getting More Than You Battled For!, she also provides additional voice direction.

She is one of only two voice actors to have worked on Pokémon the Series, Pokémon Origins, and Pokémon Generations, the other being Lucien Dodge.
